## Requirements checklist (delete if the PR doesn't touch docs/requirements)

- [ ] Documents live in `docs/requirements/<module>/<feature>/` (kebab-case)
- [ ] Every changed document was bumped with `docver.py bump` **before** editing (revision row filled, previous version in `history/`)
- [ ] Downstream documents updated and re-pinned (`--refresh-upstream`), or listed as pending below
- [ ] Evidence is linked (`docver.py linkify`); no pasted source code
- [ ] Unknowns are `Unknown` / `TBD (decision needed: …, owner: …)` with open questions; nothing invented
- [ ] `docver.py check docs/requirements` passes and `INDEX.md` is regenerated
- [ ] Reviewers: business owner for BRD changes, architect for SRD changes
